notes.title: Rules clarifications
notes.content:
Updates have been made to the rules to clarify how many Famine cards appear in years 1, 2 and 3.
Typos fixed.
The Ruler cards have been updated to have text specific to the digital version, as opposed to text specific to the physical game.

notes.title: Unity 6 Update
notes.content:
Today we rolled our Unity build forward to Unity 6, giving the game more stability and improved performance.  We also made some improvements to our dragging code to better support monitors of various resolutions.  And finally, we updated he menu button to something more standard, at the suggestion of our of our players on our Discord.

Have a suggestion or issue?  Join our Discord server and we will listen!

Happy ruling!

notes.title: Freeze Fix
notes.content:
There was a small issue that was encountered on Steam Deck and during remote play.  Double clicking or rapidly tapping on cards would trigger the Card Inspection popup to enter a broken state, freezing the game.  This patch addresses that issue, making it Steam Deck compatible, and more stable during Remote Play.

Thank you for playing Fortune and Famine!
